source_title: 내가 징기로 골드 버는 법 공유함
subtitle: 물어는 봤잖아, 판당 10골드 양심 징기

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
아무도 안 드시네요.
이 캐스터 무기, 힐 부특용으로
제가 먹어도 될까요?
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle three-quarter view inside a dungeon loot moment, with a small open wooden boss chest sitting on a minimal stone floor patch showing a glowing blue caster staff inside. On the left, the undead paladin has her two-handed golden warhammer strapped neatly on her back and clasps her empty hands politely with an innocent pleading smile toward the right. On the right, the night elf priest holds her healing staff and gives a gentle, unsuspecting nod.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
진짜 꿀단지는 비싼 탱템이지.
전탱님 안 쓰는 부위
미리 다 체크해 뒀어.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder foreground-to-background composition: close in the left foreground, the undead paladin with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back holds an unrolled parchment loot checklist and glances back over her shoulder with a sly, scheming half-smile. Further back on the right, the orc warrior tank stands casually with her one-handed sword and sturdy tanking shield equipped, completely unaware.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
저... 이 탱 방패도
부특으로 써야 하는데
먹어도 될까요? ㅠㅠ
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Low-angle side-three-quarter shot with a small open wooden chest on a minimal stone floor patch displaying a gleaming rare metal tanking shield. On the right, the undead paladin with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back clasps her empty hands together with huge, fake teary puppy-dog eyes, begging shamelessly. On the left, the orc warrior tank wearing her one-handed sword and sturdy shield looks slightly moved and gives a generous, clueless nod.

Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Wide horizontal two-shot at a minimal wooden merchant counter prop on the left: the undead paladin with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back casually slides the caster staff and tanking shield onto the counter while holding a plump tied brown leather pouch overflowing with shiny round gold coins in her other hand, smiling calmly. In the right background, the orc warrior tank with her one-handed sword and sturdy shield equipped happens to walk past and freezes completely stiff with wide blank eyes, dropped jaw, and silent shock.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
보기랑 신기 한다면서!
나오자마자 상점에 팔아?!
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic tilted medium close-up confrontation: on the left, the orc warrior tank with her one-handed sword sheathed at her hip and sturdy shield strapped to her left arm leans in furiously, pointing toward the merchant counter and yelling in outrage. On the right, the undead paladin with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped on her back and holding her brown leather coin pouch blinks calmly with an unbothered expression.

cuts.speaker: 언데드 성기사
cuts.dialogue:
그래도 양심은 있어요.
판당 10골드 벌면서
물어는 다 봤잖아요.
cuts.visual_prompt: Sleek 3.5-head-tall Korean gag webtoon style on a pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Medium solo portrait centered in frame: the undead paladin with her two-handed golden warhammer strapped neatly on her back casually tosses and catches a heavy brown leather pouch bursting with gleaming round gold coins, wearing a cool, half-lidded deadpan smirk.
